_comment: Page 1: departures board. Lead service in the top font with its calling-at line, then compact rows. Rows flow downward: calling sits dy below the lead row, compact rows sit dy below calling and repeat every pitch. Statuses keep green/red automatically.

segments._comment: Colours for the time / destination / platform parts of every service row.

exp._comment: Flipped Exp status renders as two parts ( Exp | 10:25 ) in the row font. dx slides the Exp label (0 = snug left of the time), gap spaces label and time.

plat._comment: Platform number slides by dx like Exp (0 = snug).
